theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_lc_sl_slice_identity
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (RT : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2)) (RB : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (Rs : ℝ → IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ), Measurable f → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), LocallyIntegrable (fun s => (Rs s).action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)))) → (∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (a b : ℝ), a < b → ∫ s in a..b, (Rs s).action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) = (b - a) * ((∫ x in RT.carrier, (RT.mult x : ℝ) * min 1 (max 0 ((b - f x) / (b - a))) * RT.orient x (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) x) ∂μHE[m + 2]) - ∫ x in RB.carrier, (RB.mult x : ℝ) * min 1 (max 0 ((b - f x) / (b - a))) * RB.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) x) ∂μHE[m + 1])) → ∀ᵐ t, ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), (Rs t).action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) = (∫ x in RT.carrier ∩ {x | f x < t}, (RT.mult x : ℝ) * RT.orient x (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) x) ∂μHE[m + 2]) - ∫ x in RB.carrier ∩ {x | f x < t}, (RB.mult x : ℝ) * RB.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) x) ∂μHE[m + 1]
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
